title: fix(console): an app that serves the caller no navigation opens on an app-level empty state, not the Studio home (objectui#12079)
body:
Fixes #12079

Clause-②: yes

## What changes for the user

An app that serves the signed-in user no navigation now opens on an app-level empty state instead of the Studio home.

- The title names the app: "Nothing in HotCLM is available to you yet". The label is the one the header's app switcher shows.
- A caller the console already treats as a workspace administrator reads "This app has no pages your account can open. You can grant access in Setup." and gets an **Open Setup** link.
- Everyone else reads "... Ask an administrator to grant you access." and gets no link.
- An app with a landing page still opens on it. The Studio app still opens on its own home (see "Studio is untouched").

Measured case: objectstack-ai/hotclm#87. For the dev admin, `GET /api/v1/meta/app/clm` answered `navigation: []`, because every HotCLM group is gated on a `clm_*.access` capability. That account holding no `clm_*` set is hotclm's open question (objectstack-ai/hotclm#28, objectstack-ai/hotclm#11). This PR does not take a position on it.

## Mechanism, measured on `origin/main` `023f00d4`

The PM's four assumptions, each measured:

1. **One fallback site: confirmed.** `StudioHomePage` is rendered in one place, the app index route of `AppContent` in `packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx`, when `resolveLandingRoute` returns nothing. Its other references are the lazy import beside it, the `metadata-admin` barrel export, two of its own tests, and five test mocks.
   - The reference console's `apps/console/src/AppContent.tsx` wraps `DefaultAppContent` and adds no landing logic.
   - `@objectstack/console` is built from this same source.
   - **The fallback had a second, live consumer: the Studio app.** Its served navigation is all `component` items. `findFirstRoute` walks only `object` / `page` / `dashboard` / `report` items (and groups), so `/apps/studio` has no landing and reaches the same branch with a full navigation. `UnifiedSidebar` also gives the Studio app a dedicated "Studio home" entry that points at that root.
   - So the fallback was not split on "no landing". It was split on "the app serves no navigation" (next section).
2. **The grant decision is reused, not invented.** The Setup link is gated on `useWorkspaceAdminStatus().isAdmin`. Its legs:
   - the active membership role;
   - the `user.role` scalar;
   - `user.isPlatformAdmin`;
   - `org_owner` / `org_admin` in `user.positions`.

   `AppContent` already reads this verdict (`isWorkspaceAdmin`) to decide who stays on the no-app empty state with its "System Settings" button (everyone else is bounced home). The home sidebar reads the same verdict to show its administration links into Setup. Its readiness half (`isResolved`) already gates `AppContent`'s first render, so the link cannot flicker in.

   The URL is `resolveSetupAppPath(apps)`, the policy behind the `/setup` deep link: the Setup app's root by package id, then by name.
3. **Eager closure.** The before and after readings are in the Gates table below.
4. **The empty-state primitive exists and is reused.** `Empty`, `EmptyTitle` and `EmptyDescription` from `@object-ui/components` are already in the eager closure, through `RouteNotFound` and the app-verdict screens in the same file. The new screen composes those three plus `Button`, and the `Lock` icon the header already loads.
   - A first cut used `EmptyHeader` / `EmptyMedia` / `EmptyContent`. Those have no caller in the console build, and the cut added 46 bytes gzipped to `ui-components`, which has about 3 KB of headroom. The second commit drops them.

## What changed

- `packages/app-shell/src/console/appServesNoNavigation.ts` (new): `appServesNoNavigation(app)` is true when the top-level `navigation` holds no item and no `areas[].navigation` does either.
  - It reuses the sidebar's own `hasVisibleNavigationItems` with no guards and with `hasActionHandler: true`, because the console sidebar wires an action dispatcher.
  - So a `separator` or a childless `group` counts as nothing, exactly as the sidebar draws it.
- `packages/app-shell/src/console/AppNoAccessEmptyState.tsx` (new): the screen described above.
- `packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx`: the index route now runs these steps in order:
  1. If a landing resolves, navigate to it.
  2. Otherwise, if `appServesNoNavigation(activeApp)`, render `AppNoAccessEmptyState` with `setupPath = isWorkspaceAdmin ? resolveSetupAppPath(apps) : null`.
  3. Otherwise, render `StudioHomePage` as before.
- `packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts`: four new keys in all ten packs, `empty.appNothingAvailable` (holds `{{app}}`), `empty.appNothingAvailableDescription`, `empty.appNothingAvailableGrantDescription` and `empty.openSetup`.
- `.changeset/12079-empty-nav-landing.md`: patch for `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n`.

Clause-② is `yes` as the claim declared: the four keys widen the published `@object-ui/i18n` packs. No package export was added. The two new app-shell modules are imported only by `AppContent`, and `src/index.ts` is unchanged.

## Studio is untouched

Triage says "`/studio` itself is untouched". The `/studio` pillar builder is not edited. The Studio app root `/apps/studio` still renders `StudioHomePage`, pinned by a control test below.

The card quotes the maintainer calling that page "Studio's old home, retired a long time ago". On this tree it is still the Studio app's live root: the sidebar's "Studio home" entry links to it. Retiring it would be a separate decision, and this PR leaves it alone.

## Tests

New file `packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/AppContent.emptyNavigationLanding-12079.test.tsx`, 8 tests, in the harness of `AppContent.inaccessibleAppStrand.test.tsx`: real `AppContent` and router, with the shell and the lazy pages stubbed.

- an app with `navigation: []` renders the empty state, not `StudioHomePage`, names the app, and stays on `/apps/clm`;
- a caller who is not an admin gets the "ask an administrator" copy and no Setup link;
- an admin gets the Setup link at `/apps/com.objectstack.setup`, the `resolveSetupAppPath` URL;
- a member whose app list carries Setup still gets no link: the decision reads the admin verdict, not the list;
- **control:** an app whose first group holds an `object` item still navigates to `/apps/clm/contract`;
- **control:** a Studio-shaped app (navigation of `component` items only) still renders `StudioHomePage`;
- `appServesNoNavigation`: true for no navigation, `[]`, only childless groups and separators, or empty areas; false for a `url` item, or for an item only inside an area.

**Reverse verification.** The fix is committed first. `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` from `objectstack` then mutated the anchor `if (appServesNoNavigation(activeApp)) {` in `AppContent.tsx` to `if (false && appServesNoNavigation(activeApp)) {`, with the anchor count going 1 to 0 and the blob changing on disk.

- **Ablated:** 4 failed, 4 passed. The four empty-state tests fail, and the rendered DOM shows `data-testid="studio-home-page"`, which is the defect. The two controls and the two predicate tests stay green.
- **Restored:** the blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` is empty, and the re-run is 8 passed.

## Gates

Run at HEAD `02569f3`. objectui has no `dispatch-gates.mjs`, so this list is derived by hand from the root `package.json` and `.github/workflows/`.

| Gate | Verdict |
|---|---|
| `pnpm turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/app-shell --filter=@object-ui/i18n --concurrency=2` (builds the upstream closure first; app-shell's `tsconfig.test.json` covers the new test file) | exit 0, 31 of 31 tasks |
| `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: the 14 `AppContent.*` suites in app-shell, plus the 3 console suites that mock `StudioHomePage` and `defaults-maps-mirror-en-pack` | 18 files, 185 passed |
| `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/i18n/` (includes `all-locales-key-parity`) | 82 files, 1316 passed, 13 skipped (skips predate this change) |
| `pnpm check:eager-closure` (console `vite build` before and after) | see the size line below |
| `pnpm check:eager-locale-catalogues` | exit 0; `en` resident 44.2 KB to 44.3 KB |
| `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-dead-keys` | exit 0 each; drift: 0 `en` values changed, 4 keys added |
| `check:new-line-citations`, `check:control-bytes` | 0 new citations; OK |
| `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:esm-specifiers` | exit 0 each |
| `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots` | exit 0 each |
| `check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `check-changeset-no-major.mjs`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals` | exit 0 each |
| `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` over the 15 changed paths | NOT GOVERNED |
| eslint on the 14 touched source files | 0 errors |

Eager closure size, before (`023f00d4`) and after (`02569f3`):

- **Total:** 3168.6 KB to 3168.9 KB gzipped, which is +311 bytes gzipped and +1554 bytes raw. Headroom goes from 35.9 KB to 35.6 KB, and the closure stays at 290 of 2474 chunks.
- **`index`:** +283 bytes gzipped, +1232 raw. This is the new component, the predicate and the route branch.
- **`i18n-locale-en`:** +68 bytes gzipped, +322 raw. These are the four `en` strings.
- **`ui-components`:** +8 bytes gzipped, 0 raw.
- **All other chunks:** -48 bytes gzipped in total, 0 raw. These are hash-renaming effects only.

Not run locally, because CI owns them: the repo-wide `pnpm lint`, the full `pnpm test`, Bundle Analysis and E2E.

ESLint was run on the 14 touched source files only. CI's `pnpm lint` runs `eslint .` in each package.

- **Population:** the root `eslint.config.js`. It sets no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`, so linting is not type-aware. No rule under `eslint-rules/` reads another file from disk.
- **Count:** 14 files in the `--format json` output.
- **Result:** 0 errors and 33 warnings, all 33 in `AppContent.tsx`. The base `AppContent.tsx` measured through `--stdin` also has 33, so this diff adds none.
- **Why the narrowing is sound:** each file's verdict is independent of every other file, so this diff cannot move the verdict on an untouched file.

## Acceptance notes

- **Residual, not filed:** a non-Studio app whose served navigation is non-empty but holds no item the landing resolver walks still renders `StudioHomePage`. That covers navigation of only `component`, `url` or `action` items, or items that live only under `areas`.
  - The spec says areas take precedence over the top-level `navigation`, while `resolveLandingRoute` reads only the top level.
  - The only producer measured in this shape is the Studio app itself, where the page is intended. `account`, `setup` and the `objectstack` examples all resolve a landing, and none declares `areas`.
  - Carrier: none.
- The copy says "no pages your account can open". That is also what an app that declares no navigation at all would show.
- **Live browser pass: NOT MEASURED.** It needs a backend serving an app whose navigation is empty for the signed-in user, which is the hotclm#87 setup. The routing is pinned in RTL, against the real `AppContent` and router.
